svg.font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How an event gets a workflow turn run for it on the fast path, and what the janitor does on each of its fires
svg.desc: Three bands, each read left to right. The first: an event committed to the inbox or held for folding reaches a gold gate asking whether the fast path is on and the work is due now; No drops to Durable per-event reminder, unchanged. Yes goes on to a gate asking whether the janitor reminder is asserted; Create failed drops to that same reminder box. Yes goes on to Post notification, capacity 1, coalesces, then to a gate asking whether a drive loop is running; Yes goes on to Running loop consumes it, or the reclaim handshake re-posts it. No wraps back to the left margin and into the second band. The second band: Start drive loop, then Run one turn through the reminder path. Committed goes on to a gate asking whether there are more notifications; Yes loops back underneath into the turn, No goes on to Loop exits, actor stays resident. Failed drops from the turn to a gate asking whether retry budget is left, about six seconds and jittered; Yes loops back underneath into the turn as well, No goes to Loop exits, the janitor owns recovery. A dashed line runs from there down into the third band, a dashed lane captioned Janitor fire every 20s. Inside it: Load state, then four gates in a row, each dropping a box when the answer is Yes and passing the question on when it is No. Purged or terminal drops Settle and delete the janitor; Inbox rows pending drops Drive a turn, janitor_recovered; Held completions with no driver drops Drive a turn, janitor_fold_recovered; Unresolved TaskScheduled events drops Re-dispatch activities. The last No ends at No-op, actor stays resident.
